item.title: Seeing Beyond the Natural to the Heavenly Point of View
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner takes us on a journey through the Bible, exploring the importance of having a heavenly point of view in our daily lives. Drawing from the story of Elisha and the King of Israel in 2 Kings chapter 6, Pastor Chris Zehner shows us how to navigate life's challenges with faith, trust, and spiritual vision. Join us as we discover the transformative power of a heavenly perspective and learn how to see God's plan unfolding in our lives.

item.title: When the Enemy Attacks Your Body
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: Join us for a powerful and inspiring sermon as our guest shares his heart-wrenching yet triumphant story of spiritual warfare, facing down death itself, and the miraculous intervention of God's presence in the midst of physical attack. This is a must-listen for anyone who has ever struggled with doubt, fear, or uncertainty, and for those who seek to be strengthened and empowered in their faith. You'll be challenged to stand firm in the face of adversity and to trust in the unshakeable sovereignty of God.

item.title: From the Brink of Death to Divine Intervention
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: Join us as we explore the powerful story of one believer's encounter with spiritual warfare and their incredible testimony of God's protection and healing. You'll be inspired by the pastor's unwavering faith and determination to stand on the promises of God, even in the face of overwhelming physical and spiritual attacks. Don't miss this powerful sermon that will challenge and encourage you to trust in God's goodness and sovereignty, no matter what you may be facing.

item.title: Standing Against Spiritual Attacks Through Faith and Worship
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: Join us for a powerful testimony of faith and resilience as our pastor shares a personal story of spiritual warfare and divine intervention. Learn how he refused to give in to the enemy's attacks, even when his body was weak and his condition was dire, and discover the strategies he used to take authority over the situation and trust in God's sovereignty. This sermon is a must-listen for anyone facing challenges and needing to see the power of faith in action.

item.title: When the Enemy Attacks but God Prevails
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor shares a gripping account of a life-threatening spiritual attack and how he stood firm in faith, refusing to give in to the enemy's schemes. Learn how Pastor's unwavering trust in God's power and Word led to a miraculous healing, and discover the secrets to overcoming even the most intense spiritual battles. Don't miss this inspiring and faith-building message that will leave you equipped to face any challenge that comes your way.
